<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def snap(): return current_frame.ascii
def diff(b,a):
    H=len(a); Wd=len(a[0])
    return [(rr,cc,b[rr][cc],a[rr][cc]) for rr in range(H) for cc in range(Wd) if b[rr][cc]!=a[rr][cc]]
def pillars():
    out=[]
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('B','W','c','N','p','Y') and n['pixels']>=4:
            bb=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in bb]; cs=[p[1] for p in bb]
            out.append((n['color'],min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)))
    return sorted(out,key=lambda x:(x[3],x[0]))
print("before:",pillars())
b=snap()
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':56,'col':12}])
a=snap()
ch=diff(b,a)
print("clicked (56,12): changed",len(ch))
print("after:",pillars())
print("sample",ch[:12])
print("done?",last_action_result.get('done'),"level_completed?",last_action_result.get('level_completed'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
